name: dotnet LawnDart eShop Identity
description: Identity / account bounded context for a LawnDart-style rewrite of Microsoft eShop. Built on ASP.NET Identity only, no Duende; upstream eShop uses Duende IdentityServer + ASP.NET Identity. Business process first. Register is a LawnDart addition (eShop only seeds users). Seeded demo card fields (card holder, masked card number, card type, expiration and security number) live only on the ASP.NET Identity login record in SQL, like eShop's ApplicationUser, and never in events. Key-deletion encryption of those fields is a later LawnDart item.

widgets.name: Shopper
widgets.description: A customer who registers, signs in, and shops the catalog.

widgets.name: Shopper Account
widgets.description: Aggregate root for a shopper identity account (maps to ASP.NET Identity ApplicationUser in eShop Identity.API). Stream key: shopper-account:{accountId}

state.name: IsActive
state.description: Whether the account can sign in

widgets.name: Register Shopper Account
widgets.description: Creates a new shopper account with credentials and basic profile. Produces Shopper Account Registered. The password is hashed into the ASP.NET Identity login store and never goes on events.

state.name: AccountId
state.description: Identifier to assign to the new account

widgets.name: Shopper Account Registered
widgets.description: A shopper account was created. Tagged: shopper-account:{accountId}

widgets.name: Register
widgets.description: Self-service registration form (LawnDart addition; stock eShop AccountController has no Register action).

widgets.name: Email Already Registered
widgets.description: An account with this email already exists (email compared trimmed, case-insensitive). A taken user name is User Name Already Registered.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given no prior account, when Register Shopper Account then Shopper Account Registered.

widgets.name: Duplicate email
widgets.description: Given an account already registered with the same email, when Register Shopper Account then Email Already Registered.

widgets.name: User Name Already Registered
widgets.description: Fires when an ASP.NET Identity login with this user name already exists: checked before the account is reserved (FindByNameAsync), and again as DuplicateUserName when the login user is created. Message: "An account with this user name already exists."

widgets.name: User Name Invalid
widgets.description: Fires when the ASP.NET Identity user validator rejects the user name (InvalidUserName), e.g. a character outside the default allowed set of letters, digits and -._@+. Message: "User name is invalid."

widgets.name: Password Requirements Not Met
widgets.description: Fires when an ASP.NET Identity password validator rejects the password. The default rules apply: at least 6 characters, with a digit, a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a non-alphanumeric character. The message lists the rules that failed.

widgets.name: Duplicate user name
widgets.description: Given an account already registered with the same user name, when Register Shopper Account then User Name Already Registered.

widgets.name: Invalid user name
widgets.description: Given no prior account, when Register Shopper Account with a user name containing a space then User Name Invalid.

widgets.name: Weak password
widgets.description: Given no prior account, when Register Shopper Account with password "abc" then Password Requirements Not Met.

widgets.name: Shopper Account Profile
widgets.description: Projection of shopper account identity and default address fields. No payment-card fields.

widgets.name: Account Profile
widgets.description: Display of Shopper Account Profile read model.

widgets.name: Sign In Shopper
widgets.description: Checks the password against the ASP.NET Identity login store and appends Shopper Signed In. Issues no cookie or Duende token.

state.name: UserName
state.description: User name. Sign-in is by user name only; an email address is not accepted.

widgets.name: Shopper Signed In
widgets.description: Shopper successfully authenticated. This is the business event for sign-in; cookies and tokens are infrastructure.

widgets.name: Login
widgets.description: Login screen (maps to Identity.API Account/Login and WebApp LogIn).

widgets.name: Invalid Credentials
widgets.description: User name or password is incorrect, or account is locked/disabled.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given a registered account, when Sign In Shopper with correct password then Shopper Signed In.

widgets.name: Bad credentials
widgets.description: Given a registered account, when Sign In Shopper with wrong password then Invalid Credentials.

widgets.name: Sign Out Shopper
widgets.description: Ends the shopper's ASP.NET Identity session and appends Shopper Signed Out.

state.name: LogoutId
state.description: Optional logout context id from the client. ASP.NET Identity has no logout context, so it is accepted and not applied.

widgets.name: Shopper Signed Out
widgets.description: Shopper session ended.

widgets.name: Logout
widgets.description: Confirm / trigger logout.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given Shopper Signed In, when Sign Out Shopper then Shopper Signed Out.

widgets.name: Shopper Account Not Found
widgets.description: Fires when the shopper account does not exist or is not active. Message: "Shopper account does not exist."

widgets.name: Unknown account
widgets.description: Given no account, when Sign Out Shopper then Shopper Account Not Found.

widgets.name: Update Shopper Profile
widgets.description: Updates shopper profile fields used as checkout defaults.

widgets.name: Shopper Profile Updated
widgets.description: Shopper profile fields changed.

widgets.name: Manage Account
widgets.description: Manage account / profile form (Identity Manage views).

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given Shopper Account Registered, when Update Shopper Profile then Shopper Profile Updated.

widgets.name: Shopper Account Not Found
widgets.description: Fires when the shopper account does not exist. Checked after the account id, name and last name are present. Message: "Shopper account does not exist."

widgets.name: Unknown account
widgets.description: Given no account, when Update Shopper Profile then Shopper Account Not Found.

widgets.name: Grant Client Consent
widgets.description: Shopper grants a client application the scopes it requested.

widgets.name: Client Consent Granted
widgets.description: Shopper granted a client application consent for the requested scopes.

widgets.name: Consent
widgets.description: Consent page listing the scopes a client application requests.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given Shopper Signed In, when Grant Client Consent then Client Consent Granted.

swimlanes.name: Register Shopper Account
swimlanes.description: Shopper self-registration. Built on ASP.NET Identity, no Duende. The handler reserves the trimmed email, appends Shopper Account Registered, then inserts the ASP.NET Identity login user (same id as the account; PasswordHasher stores the hash, never on events). eShop only seeds alice/bob and has no public Register action.

swimlanes.name: Shopper Account Profile
swimlanes.description: Read model of a shopper account for manage-account and checkout defaults. Subscribes to Registered and Profile Updated. Address only, no payment-card fields. Ordering's Place Order carries the masked card snapshot. The seeded demo card fields (holder, masked number, type, expiration, security number) stay on the ASP.NET Identity login record in SQL only, like eShop's ApplicationUser, and never appear on events or this view. Key-deletion encryption is a later LawnDart item.

swimlanes.name: Sign In Shopper
swimlanes.description: Shopper signs in with user name and password. ASP.NET Identity only, no Duende. The command checks the password against the ASP.NET Identity login store (CheckPasswordSignInAsync, lockout on failure) and appends Shopper Signed In, the business event. Cookies and tokens are infrastructure for a later slice.

swimlanes.name: Sign Out Shopper
swimlanes.description: Shopper ends the authenticated session (eShop AccountController.Logout). ASP.NET Identity only, no Duende. Appends Shopper Signed Out, the business event; clearing the ASP.NET Identity sign-in cookie is infrastructure.

swimlanes.name: Update Shopper Profile
swimlanes.description: Shopper updates profile name, contact, and default shipping address (Identity Manage area / ApplicationUser fields).

swimlanes.name: Grant Client Consent
swimlanes.description: Thin client consent grant: the shopper approves the scopes a client application requests. ASP.NET Identity only, no Duende, so there is no consent server behind this slice yet. Deferred: not built for now. It stays in the model.
